dominant_recessive_swap.feedback: Dominant traits appear in F1 even with one copy (Tt looks tall); recessive traits appear only when both alleles are recessive (tt is short).
dominant_recessive_swap.calm_prompt: Which trait shows up in F1 — dominant or recessive?

genotype_phenotype_swap.feedback: Genotype is the genetic makeup (TT, Tt, tt); phenotype is the visible expression (tall or short).

monohybrid_dihybrid_swap.feedback: Monohybrid cross tracks one trait pair (tall/short); dihybrid cross tracks two trait pairs (seed shape and colour) showing independent assortment.
monohybrid_dihybrid_swap.calm_prompt: One trait or two traits in this cross?

sex_determination_confusion.feedback: In humans, the father determines sex — X sperm → female (XX), Y sperm → male (XY). The mother always contributes an X chromosome.
sex_determination_confusion.calm_prompt: Which parent's gamete carries X or Y?

variation_inheritance_swap.feedback: Variation within a species helps survival when conditions change; heredity transmits traits while variation creates differences among offspring.
variation_inheritance_swap.calm_prompt: Same traits from parents, or differences among siblings?
